home.headline: I turn complex workflows into accessible interfaces.
home.introduction: Hi, I’m Carl, and I’m excited to apply for BNY’s Director, Product Design role. I bring more than 15 years of experience designing public services and the tools behind them. The opportunity to work through complex problems with your Fund & Investor Solutions team, while helping designers develop their work, is what draws me to this role.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve tailored the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to your team: connecting complex workflows, making research useful, and developing patterns that others can build on.
home.who: I'm a New York–based product designer and UX leader who combines interaction design with front-end development. I’ve designed public services and internal tools, and managed and mentored designers as a UX Director. Digital accessibility is part of how I approach every project.
home.what: I work with stakeholders and developers to understand the needs of people using a service and the teams supporting it. Research, workflow mapping, and prototypes help me turn those needs into clear interfaces and explain the decisions behind them. I build reusable components and documentation so teams can implement and maintain shared patterns.
